channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Not a toy: Police find M-16 hiding in preschool sandbox
item.description: After receiving a report of gunfire on a vehicle, police raid complex and find M-16 assault rifle hiding in preschool sandbox.

item.title: Watch: IDF embarks on humanitarian operation in Colombia
item.description: Home Front Command delegation departs for Colombia following logistical preparations.

item.title: Wholeheartedness is the key
item.description: Hashem adjures us to ‘cleave to Him’ - and as Hashem is upright and righteous, one who wants to cleave to Him, has to also be ‘upright and righteous’.

item.title: A note on the Catholic Church's mini-October 7th
item.description: The outcry over Hamel’s killing lasted only as long as it took for the ink on the page the following day to dry. And Pope Francis, after Hamel’s murder, said: “If I speak of Islamic violence I must also speak of Catholic violence." He really said that. Opinion.

item.title: Hilltop activists re-erect tent in Qusra
item.description: Hilltop anarchists re-erected a tent in Qusra this morning at the same location where it had previously stood, after the IDF deployed an additional battalion to the village and the Border Police reinforced its forces in the area.

item.title: IDF confirms: Terrorist who held numerous hostages eliminated
item.description: IDF confirms elimination of Muhammad Mushtaha, who infiltrated Israel and held Tsachi Idan, Corporal Noa Marciano, Ziv Berman, Omri Miran, Ori Megidish, Naama Levy, and Matan Angrerst hostage.

item.title: August. Everyone is on Vacation. Hamas isn't.
item.description: During the past week, more than 65 incidents of crossings into the yellow zone in the Gaza Strip were recorded, and in none of them was fire opened. Warning.

item.title: Ebola concern in Israel ruled out
item.description:
The Health Ministry announced that tests for Ebola conducted on a person who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo after being suspected of contracting the virus came back negative.
The ministry stressed that, at this time, no confirmed case of Ebola has been diagnosed in Israel.

item.title: Arab reports: Three fishermen injured by Israeli Navy gunfire off the coast of Gaza
item.description: Palestinian Arab sources are reporting that three fishermen were wounded as a result of gunfire from an Israeli naval vessel off the coast of Gaza City.

item.title: Katz orders IDF to transfer civilian enforcement in Judea and Samaria to police
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz orders a plan to shift civilian enforcement in Judea and Samaria from the IDF to police as the military focuses on security.

item.title: Gaslighting on steroids
item.description: The libels against Israel are all falling apart. The libels are not acknowledged because they are driven by the incontrovertible antisemitic - if insane - belief that Israel is a unique force for evil in the world. Opinion.

item.title: Report: China suspected of funding anti-Israel protests in UK
item.description:
American politicians are examining suspicions of covert Chinese funding for the activities of Code Pink in Britain, which has held pro-Palestinian demonstrations in the country, according to a report in The Telegraph.
As part of the investigation, payments totaling approximately £250,000 to a company linked to the organization are being examined. The funds were allegedly received from companies connected to technology mogul Neville Roy Singham.

item.title: Piers Morgan raked over the coals after calling Netanyahu 'Idiot'
item.description: Piers Morgan calls Netanyahu 'idiot' after referring to UK as 'Islamic Republic,' but thousands of commenters back up Prime Minister with facts.

item.title: The X-factor against drones: IDF revives elite weapons course
item.description: The month-long course returns with lessons from combat, training on specialized weapons, and new tools to help elite units counter the growing drone threat.

item.title: Podcast: Welcoming the amazing month of Elul!
item.description: "Judges and officers you shall appoint at all your gates": The gates of consciousness.

item.title: Maariv poll: Coalition drops to 48 seats
item.description:
A Maariv poll published on Friday morning shows the coalition bloc weakening by one seat this week, standing at just 48 seats. The coalition's decline is a direct result of Likud losing one seat, dropping to 21.
Seat breakdown in the poll: Yashar (led by Eisenkot) 23, Likud 21, Together (led by Bennett) 14, Yisrael Beytenu 10, The Democrats 10, Otzma Yehudit 8, United Torah Judaism 8, Shas 7, Hadash-Ta'al 6, Ra'am 5, Religious Zionist party 4, Zionist Home (led by Tropper and Hendel) 4.
The Zionist opposition bloc reaches 57 seats, and together with Chili Tropper and Yoaz Hendel could form a majority of 61 seats. The Arab parties account for an additional 11 seats.

item.title: Mansour Abbas sets election goal: Ra'am will be the decisive kingmaker
item.description: Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas declares that his party aims to be at the center of decision-making following the elections: "No one will dictate our role in politics."

item.title: Will United Torah Judaism split after the elections?
item.description: According to haredi analyst Yaakov Rivlin, United Torah Judaism is expected to break up into two independent factions following the elections and conduct separate coalition negotiations.

item.title: New poll: Likud surges as coalition gains ground
item.description: A new Direct Polls survey projects 30 Knesset seats for Likud and 23 for Gadi Eisenkot’s slate. The governing coalition reaches 59 seats, while the center-left bloc stands at 50.

item.title: Idan Amedi breaks down in tears as he dedicates song to Hadar Goldin's parents
item.description: During his performance at the Sultan's Pool, Amedi addresses Simcha and Leah Goldin in the audience, reflecting on their bond over the years and thanking them for their dedicated service to the nation.

item.title: Young woman abducted from central Israel group home, rescued in Hebron
item.description: Woman in her 20s forcibly taken in a vehicle by her family members from the Dan region. A joint operation by police and IDF forces leads to her rescue in Hebron.

item.title: US slaps tariffs on imported drones and components, including from key allies
item.description: President Donald Trump announces new tariffs on foreign drones and components, citing overreliance on overseas suppliers and national security risks.

item.title: Motorcyclist in his 40s seriously injured in Holon crash
item.description:
A motorcyclist in his 40s was seriously injured in a collision with a vehicle in Holon.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided medical treatment at the scene and evacuated him to Wolfson Hospital.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary warns Iran of 'unprecedented' economic isolation
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announces upcoming historic economic isolation measures against Iran alongside the ongoing naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Saudi Crown Prince meets with CENTCOM commander
item.description:
Saudi Crown Prince and de facto ruler, Prince Mohammed bin Salman, met with the commander of the United States Central Command (CENTCOM), Admiral Brad Cooper, the Saudi state news agency reported.
According to the report, the two discussed bolstering military and defense cooperation between Washington and Riyadh, as well as reviewing joint efforts to curb escalation and maintain regional stability and security in the Middle East.

item.title: Two UAE state vessels targeted in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Two UAE state oil vessels attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Abu Dhabi to condemn Iranian strikes in the region.

item.title: Report: US military has lost roughly 45 attack and reconnaissance drones since war began
item.description: The Washington Post reports that the US military has lost approximately 45 advanced MQ-9 Reaper drones out of the 185 it possessed prior to the outbreak of the war.

item.title: Vance: US aims to stabilize oil prices and stop Iranian nuke capability
item.description: VP JD Vance tells Fox News that US strategy in Iran centers on stabilizing energy costs and barring Tehran from developing nuclear weapons.

item.title: 'The Reservists' attack Smotrich: You chose to represent draft evaders and forgot those who serve
item.description:
The Zionist Home - The Reservists party slammed Bezalel Smotrich's "Reservists Plan," arguing that reducing the number of reserve duty days fails to address the underlying soldier shortage.
"You chose to represent draft evaders and forgot those who serve - the serving public will not forget this," the party stated.

item.title: Rock-throwing attack near Kiryat Arba leaves five lightly injured
item.description: Club-wielding terrorists ambush a resident walking in the area. Security forces rushed to the scene come under a barrage of rocks, leaving five people with minor injuries.
